method.clip_bounds: score-aligned hard edits, not exact live-play boundaries
method.grid: every sixth source frame at 30 fps, inside each edited clip
method.positions: existing near-floor-side raw detector box-bottom court candidates
method.missingness: unscreened frames explicit; fewer than six not filled; more than six ambiguous
method.identity_status: raw IDs and side candidates are not independently source-validated for every instant

interpretation: This is a full edited-clip coverage register for the 18 frozen points. It exports candidate court positions where the dense screen sampled a frame and makes unscreened and incomplete frames explicit. It does not infer missing players, select a six-person roster from ambiguous proposals, certify live-play phase, or validate full-rally trajectories or outcome metrics.
